title: 9 March 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 58th evening show at the Cavern Club. It was also the 22nd occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows at the venue.

Overall this was their 150th appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including their lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Melbourne Cricket Ground, Melbourne
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo
  • 1984: UK single release: Borrowed Time by John Lennon
  • 1979: Mixing: Arrow Through Me by Wings
  • 1973: Recording: Photograph, Step Lightly by Ringo Starr
  • 1973: Television: James Paul McCartney
  • 1972: Recording, mixing: The Luck Of The Irish by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1972: Recording: Single Pigeon by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Dear Boy by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1967: Recording: Getting Better
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Granada Cinema, London – their second tour begins, with Chris Montez and Tommy Roe
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
